title: Recognify- Recognification simplified
tagline: Building the new identities of tomorrow . Creating provable credentials for the physical representation of the you.
description:
As the Web is transforming every day, it isn't easy to measure the credentials of a developer/individual's past proven experience in learning and development. Hence, we have built a platform that streamlines measuring a metric for an individual portfolio for the respective skill.

Problem statement:
there is no standard metric to assess the individual. creating credentials for individuals will help them prove themselves
how_its_made:
1. Tailwind module conflicts with WAGMI JS- created a new react application to rerun packages
2. GraphQL subgraph, not having effciency in terms of sub graphs for erc-4973 
3. in house engine for creating generating ERC-4973 for bulk users.
4.Since Infura has no outright support to provide deployment on the Mumbai testnet
